queries.query: Look for studies on structure-function relationships of proteins in human health and biotechnology that are linked to projects continuing from the MX-2398 proposal and are scheduled for release in 2026.
Look for research on proteins related to pathogenesis of diseases where the project involves both human and viral protein targets and is scheduled for data release after June 12, 2026.
Look for research on nucleic acid-protein complexes in structural biology that utilizes the ID23-2 instrument and is scheduled for release in 2026.
Find research on macromolecular crystallography where the publication year is greater than 2025 and the project includes studies on chromosome organization.
Find studies on Cu-Nb multilayers that involve complementary measurements and are scheduled for release on or after January 24, 2027.
Look for studies on Amelogenesis Imperfecta where the focus is on hypoplastic subtype and the publication year is set for 2027.
Look for studies on forbidden reflections in germanium where the experiment is scheduled between December 4 and 5, 2024, and the publication year is 2027.
Look for studies on cryogenic X-ray holographic nanotomography of biological tissues scheduled between November 1 and November 6, 2024, and involving the ID16A instrument.
Look for datasets from the Integrated Ligand Screening Pipelines project conducted at ESRF where the number of datasets is greater than 7,000 and the instrument used is ID30B.
Find studies on the 3D structure of the human dentate gyrus where the sample pixel size is less than 0.1 and the publication year is 2024.
Find studies on cryo-electron microscopy where the EM sampling rate is greater than 0.4 and the magnification is 105000.
Look for studies on high-pressure nitridation reactions in diamond anvil cells where the publication year is set for 2025.
Search for studies on Fe(II) spin-crossover complexes where the pressure is less than 2.3 GPa and the publication year is 2025.
Find research on single particle cryo-electron microscopy in Italy where the publication year is 2025 and the application aims to enhance access to the CM01 beamline.
Find datasets on wicking in polyethylene terephthalate (PET) yarns where the voxel size is 2.75 um and the beam energy is 20.0 keV.
Find datasets related to detector test data from the BrightnESS project where the dataset size is greater than 121568708 bytes and the publication year is 2018.

Look for studies on the effects of Friction Stir Welding process parameters on residual stress development in Ti-6Al-4V welds where the experiment energy is greater than 1.5 and the publication year is 2013.
Find information on aerospace components associated with the SALSA instrument where the sample formula is Al Ti-4Al 6V and the publication year is 2016.
